correctness.rationale: Each weakly monotone map is specified by its interval kernel partition B and increasing image I. Direct substitution into fgf=f and gfg=g yields reciprocal transversal conditions, hence the rank-r matrix is the operator X↦M X^T M. The interval-transversal matrix M has full row rank: its rows are the squarefree coefficient vectors of products of block sums; setting z_n=0 inductively isolates nonsingleton final blocks and then final singleton blocks. For a=binom(n-1,r-1), b=binom(n,r), SVD yields a(a+1)/2 positive, a(a-1)/2 negative and a(b-a) zero eigenvalues, summing via Vandermonde to the claimed central-binomial global rank and inertia. Boundary n=1 and all strata including r=n work. Independent construction of the entire inverse matrix for n=1..4 confirmed signs (1,0,0),(2,0,1),(5,1,4),(14,6,15), respectively; this finite calculation corroborates the unrestricted proof.
